source_refs.note: Exercise 5.1 (book p. 154), Question 10; answer key PDF 306 (Answers 5.1, key numbered 12).

blocks.prompt: 10. Check whether the following lines are concurrent or not. If concurrent, then find the point of concurrency \(x + 2y - 7 = 0\); \(3x - y - 4 = 0\); \(2x + 35y - 145 = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 'check karo' wala sawal hai: jawab haan ya na hai, aur point sirf haan ki soorat mein nikalna hai.
Theorem 3 kehta hai: teen non-parallel lines tab concurrent hain jab un ke coefficients ka determinant zero ho.
Plan: pehle dekhein koi do lines parallel to nahi, phir determinant, phir faisla.
Aakhir mein point wale tareeqe se tasdeeq bhi karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x + 2y - 7 = 0\), \(3x - y - 4 = 0\), \(2x + 35y - 145 = 0\).
Maloom karna: kya yeh concurrent hain; agar hain to common point.
Tareeqa: Theorem 3 (Example 10 ki tarah).
Socho: agar determinant zero aata to hum point bhi nikalte; zero nahi aaya to kaam wahin khatam, sirf natija likhna hai. Lekin tasdeeq ke liye point wala tareeqa phir bhi istemal karenge.

Kya koi do lines parallel hain?
Slopes: \(-\frac{1}{2}\), \(3\), \(-\frac{2}{35}\); teeno alag hain.
Kyun: Theorem 3 sirf non-parallel lines ke liye hai, is liye pehle yeh dekh liya.

Coefficients ka determinant
\[\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & -7 \\ 3 & -1 & -4 \\ 2 & 35 & -145 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 1(145 + 140) - 2(-435 + 8)\]
\[\quad - 7(105 + 2)\]
\[= 285 + 854 - 749\]
\[= 390 \ne 0\]
Kyun: pehli row ke saath \(+, -, +\) signs ke saath expand kiya: \((-1)(-145) - (-4)(35) = 145 + 140 = 285\), \(3(-145) - (-4)(2) = -435 + 8 = -427\), \(3(35) - (-1)(2) = 105 + 2 = 107\). Phir \(285 - 2(-427) - 7(107) = 285 + 854 - 749\).
Dhyan dein: \(-2 \times (-427) = +854\); do minus mil kar plus.
Itne bare numbers mein ghalti ka imkaan zyada hai, is liye har minor alag likh kar hal karein aur phir jama karein.

Natija
Determinant zero nahi, is liye lines concurrent nahi hain; teeno mil kar ek chhota sa triangle banati hain, ek point par nahi milti.
Agar determinant zero aata to hum pehli do lines ka meeting point point of concurrency likhte.

Tasdeeq:
Pehli do lines wahan milti hain jahan \(y = 3x - 4\) aur \(x + 2(3x - 4) = 7\), yani \(\left(\frac{15}{7}, \frac{17}{7}\right)\) par. Teesri line mein rakhein:
\[2\left(\tfrac{15}{7}\right) + 35\left(\tfrac{17}{7}\right) - 145\]
\[= \tfrac{30}{7} + 85 - 145 = -\tfrac{390}{7} \ne 0\]
Yani teesri line is point se nahi guzarti. Yeh answer key (number 12) se milta hai: not concurrent. Mazedar baat: \(-\frac{390}{7}\) mein bhi wohi 390 nazar aa raha hai jo determinant tha.
blocks.final_answer: Determinant \(= 390 \ne 0\): lines concurrent nahi hain, is liye koi point of concurrency nahi.
